author: legosean10
body:
I just hopped on a new flatworld I created and decided I'd try to make something that could* be used as a hub or spawn of a small server. The theme is something that I reckon could be used for a nexus or CTH map, so if you want to take it, and turn it into something, go ahead! I may be making one soon =D I know it is quite basic, especially for some of the amazing builders, but I think it turned out okay (especially with shaders!)

*I'm not submitting it to any server, or requesting it be the new avicus hub or anything of that sort, I just mean that is kinda has the "theme" or "concept" that would be the same as a hub, with pathways, an area to display the owners / staff etc...
Screenshot:

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/folder/sl6plap1580f8/
